lunge.desc: attacker offset toward the target, then back

hit_stop.desc: freeze actor and target motion clocks for hit_stop_ms[class]; effect overlays keep running

tint_flash.desc: white tint on the struck avatar

knockback.desc: decaying slide away from the attacker; cosmetic, never moves the tile

shake.desc: translation shake with a small rotation that decays

recoil.desc: lean away and settle, with a small overshoot

fall.desc: drop to the lying pose with a bounce

motions_resolve: params = by_verb[verb] when present, else by_class[class]; a motion with neither for the act is a table error

face.maps_to: ActorCmd::Face / Action::Turn (style 0..7); even directions only when seated; refused when lying

gesture.maps_to: Room::act with Action wave|blow|laugh|thumbs|sign|stop|dance|idle; refused while walking or lying (action_not_here)

forced_step.maps_to: R6 forced step: one-tile Room::request_walk, order opposite, two neighbours, else nobody moves; standing avatars only

walk_to.maps_to: Room::request_walk to the door tile; plan id act:<act_id>

effect.maps_to: actors: ActorCmd::Appearance{effect} with restore; humans: client overlay that never touches Avatar.effect

hold.maps_to: planner lock for ms (body commands answer act_busy)

verb.maps_to: nested invocation of another verb's actor-role steps on the reactor

sfx.maps_to: PerfectmanUi::Sfx cue (cue-vocab sfx, five new names added)

caption.maps_to: overlay text near the actor; cinematic runs also PerfectmanUi::Caption

motion.maps_to: procedural client motion (new, one of the seven in motions)

glare.notes: Table end = Tc + 2000. Witnesses owe a reaction only when the pair already reached rung 2 in this scene.

insult.notes: Against a human the line (act.text) is spoken only after the chip answer is take. Dodge and push_back speak nothing.

shove.notes: A target that is not standing and still is not moved: the face jolt replaces the forced step and act_done lists downgraded:[forced_step].

slap.notes: Against a human only cosmetic client steps run on the target (no face, no expression).

kill.notes: The victim half is the nested die verb. Victim becomes dying at Tc + hit_stop; actor_death follows in the same tick. A human victim is down for human_down_ms and gets no actor_death.

die.notes: Standalone die is authored: needs the actor in may_die. Nested under kill it is gated by kill. The state step 'dying' emits actor_death (actors) or human_down (humans). Table end = Tc + 2300 for actors; humans end after the down time.

recoil.notes: Also the nested reaction verb. 'target' is the thing recoiled from; absent means no face step.

freeze_gasp.notes: Also the default nested witness reaction. A walking actor cannot stop mid-walk (no primitive): the expression and cue still count as the visible response.

hug.notes: Parity with the existing pair act: initiator blow at Tc, partner sign 11 at Tc+300. Against a human the target steps run only on take; a timeout completes with the initiator steps only.

text.pt-BR: * {actor} dá um beijo no rosto de {target} *

kiss.notes: Cheek or air kiss with a heart. The staging never shows lip contact: the lunge is 4 px and the heart carries it. A human who does not answer is treated as dodge.

turn_back.notes: offset 4 = 180 degrees from the direction toward the target (opposite). A seated actor snaps to an even direction; a lying actor cannot turn (act_done lists downgraded:[face]). Without a target the actor turns 180 degrees from the current facing. When the actor is the aggressor toward the target this lowers rung_cur(actor to target) to at most 2.

cry.notes: Sadness stays slow: the shake is 1 px over 4 s (motions.shake.by_verb.cry).

storm_off.notes: Ends at Tarr + 500 (Tarr is the walk's arrived frame). The hotel stops at the door tile; leaving the room is the sidecar's move_room after act_done, when the scenario allows travel. With no route to the door the walk step is skipped, the act ends at Tc + 400 and act_done lists downgraded:[walk_to].

tableau.notes: Every actor within tableau_radius_tiles of the actor (and of the target when given), standing or sitting and alive, holds: body commands answer act_busy, chat stays allowed. Humans are never held. Also the follow_up of slap, punch, kill and faint.

restrain.notes: Actor to actor only. The victim is the aggressor's most recent act target in this scene if still within 2 tiles, else the nearest other avatar, else the actor (RES-1). rung_reset lowers rung_cur(aggressor to victim) to at most 2.

faint.notes: Alive marker is Twinkle (die uses TrippyHalo). WAKE-1: a tend_fallen act that starts on the fainted actor shortens the lying phase to end 1500 ms after the tender's contact. Lying is refused while walking or with no room to lie: posture falls back to sit_floor.

tend_fallen.notes: Target must be a body: a faint actor, a dying or body actor, or a human who is down. Otherwise actor_error bad_target detail not_fallen. The kneel is sit_floor (no real kneel pose exists).
